summary: Backend-only deployment recovery validation completed. Dockerfile/Railway contracts pass, local uvicorn startup works, and Azure/auth route contracts are preserved.
action_items: No code changes required for this scope.
Deploy the current revision to Railway when ready to validate runtime there.
Environment note: Docker CLI is unavailable here, so image build/run could not be executed directly in this workspace.
critical_code_review_comments: Dockerfile explicitly installs backend/requirements.txt (including uvicorn), verifies uvicorn import, installs ca-certificates+ffmpeg, and starts on dynamic PORT via exec uvicorn server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8001}.
railway.json correctly uses builder DOCKERFILE with dockerfilePath="Dockerfile" and healthcheckPath="/api/"; no conflicting Nixpacks startCommand remains.
.dockerignore excludes backend/.env, frontend, and tests from image context; no production URL hardcoded in Dockerfile/railway.json.
Azure Speech contracts preserved: region francecentral via env validation, voice fr-FR-AlainNeural, rate -5%, STT/TTS routes present, and tts_cache lookup+insert still in server flow.
Auth recovery routes remain registered locally: POST /api/auth/password/forgot and POST /api/auth/password/reset.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 targeted pytest + local uvicorn /api/ 200 + pip check/ffmpeg checks passed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: No blocker found in deployment recovery scope. Docker binary absence is an environment limitation, not a Dockerfile defect.
rca_of_issue: Consistent with monorepo detection failure: root-level Nixpacks did not install backend dependencies, causing uvicorn missing at runtime. Current Dockerfile-based build path addresses this by explicit backend requirements installation and deterministic CMD startup.
